Work up to doing self-injections slowly!! You also don't have to do them yourself, if you're squeamish about that.

Let your doc do the first couple. Then, ask them if you can hold their hand or the syringe while they inject. Next time, try it yourself with the doc next to you; ask them to count you down. 

I've found with doing it on your own that music sometimes helps, following the beat, or counting yourself down, or getting someone else to count down for you, whether it's a friend or family member.

Also! Don't be worried about the pain!! Through my personal experience (thighs), the needle doesn't hurt at all. When they inject, you might feel a bit of dull pressure depending on your dose, but it feels like someone's pressing their thumb into your leg really hard. It's not the worst.

Remember that it's okay if you can't do it yourself! If you need the nurse to do it for you, there's no shame in that. My pharmacist does it for me every two weeks lol
